slides.title: Breaking a complex system (like a network) into smaller, manageable chunks calle
slides.body:
Breaking a complex system (like a network) into smaller, manageable chunks called layers each with a defined role, to simplify complex tasks, we break them down into smaller, manageable parts, each part is called a layer

slides.title: The power of this model lies in simplicity :
slides.body:
The power of this model lies in simplicity : 
Each layer focuses only on its specific task
A layer provides a service to the layer above it and relies on the services of the layer below it
Importantly, it doesn't need to know how the layers above and below it work
